# smol-toml

The Console harness doctor reads Codex project configuration before project packages are installed. The seven JavaScript files in this directory are the original ESM parser modules from `package/dist/` in the npm release. Copyright Squirrel Chat et al. [BSD-3-Clause license](./LICENSE)

The pinned release is `smol-toml@1.9.1`. Git tag `v1.9.1` resolves to `69aa050fef018b71799519bb2cbb54f158a0c5f9`. [Upstream source](https://github.com/squirrelchat/smol-toml/tree/69aa050fef018b71799519bb2cbb54f158a0c5f9) · [Published archive](https://registry.npmjs.org/smol-toml/-/smol-toml-1.9.1.tgz)

When updating, verify the archive against its npm SHA-512 integrity, copy the license and the modules imported by `parse.js`, then run the harness doctor tests from a clean clone. The integrity for this release is `sha512-j7WyPdf0CJoutMzMoPLF/bVXHtKZIT9Rb4eGeEbWw8X2t5oirjPgpL+OpaENZrILYaXqYwnVH+qgUwVbl+pUJQ==`.
